schema_info.description: Zunexa Free-Mode intelligent content bank. Loaded at runtime by the TemplateEngine (templates-engine.js) to extend or replace the built-in ZX_LANG_BANK. Free-plan users get high-variety, niche-aware, tone-aware content WITHOUT calling a paid AI provider.

placeholders.{topic}: the subject the user typed (e.g. 'fitness coaching', 'real estate in Casablanca')
placeholders.{niche}: optional detected niche label, used for hashtag selection only

schema_info.combinatorics_note: The engine combines hook x body x cta x hashtag-set across tones, so the *effective* number of unique generated posts is languages x tones x hooks x bodies x ctas x hashtag-sets, not just the raw item count.
